project.researchNotes: Catalogue-addition gate review. The score measures the settlement itself and does not transfer points from nearby attractions or neighbouring villages.

touristAppeal.label: Notable Stop
touristAppeal.summary: A very small former fishing village with a distinctive Finnan-haddie story, surviving historic character and an exposed coastal setting.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Outdoor walking suits dogs, but narrow roads, exposed cliffs, livestock and wildlife, steps and rough or overgrown paths require close control.

townGuide.characterTag: Finnan haddie fishing village and exposed coast
townGuide.headline: A tiny coastal village with one unusually strong story
townGuide.intro: Findon remains at 61% because the village itself has a distinctive fishing identity, the documented Finnan-haddie association and immediate clifftop character. Portlethen services, Old Portlethen, Downies and wider coastal attractions are not counted.
perfectFor: The Findon section of a longer coastal walk

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Village and moor
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Walk through the old village, read its Finnan-haddie story, then use the current path information for a cautious clifftop extension.

dontMiss: Findon Fishing Village and Finnan Haddie Story
townGuide.visitorMood: Quiet, residential and exposed, with a distinctive story but almost no visitor infrastructure.
townGuide.practicalNote: No current in-village café, formal visitor car park, public toilet or serviced picnic site was verified. The council settlement statement describes Findon as having no services and depending on Portlethen.
townGuide.transportNote: Check the current Stagecoach journey planner before travelling. Findon has no railway station.
townGuide.accessibilityNote: Narrow village roads and rough, stepped coastal paths limit accessibility. No designated accessible visitor parking or accessible public toilet has been verified.

features.name: Old Portlethen–Findon Moor Circuit
features.shortDescription: A published 5.7-mile circuit linking Old Portlethen, Findon Moor and Findon village, with coastal paths, steps, rough sections and the Findon Burn crossing.

editorialReview.scoreRationale: This is the strongest conventional walk that explicitly includes Findon and provides detailed route instructions, distance and mapping. It is a wider circuit, so only the Findon section supports the village audit.
